definitions.explanation: a severe, humiliating defeat, especially in competition or conflict

examples.japanese: チームは{惨敗|ざんぱい}を{喫|きっ}した。
examples.english: The team suffered a crushing defeat.

examples.japanese: {選挙|せんきょ}で{惨敗|ざんぱい}した。
examples.english: They were defeated badly in the election.

notes:
USAGE:
- {惨敗|ざんぱい}する (to suffer a crushing defeat)
- {惨敗|ざんぱい}を{喫|きっ}する (to suffer a crushing defeat - formal)

CONTEXTS:
- Sports: {惨敗|ざんぱい}を{喫|きっ}した (suffered a devastating loss)
- Elections: {選挙|せんきょ}で{惨敗|ざんぱい} (election rout)
- Business: {競合|きょうごう}に{惨敗|ざんぱい} (lost badly to competitors)

SCALE OF DEFEAT (most to least severe):
- {惨敗|ざんぱい} (crushing defeat)
- {大敗|たいはい} (big defeat)
- {敗北|はいぼく} (defeat)
- {惜敗|せきはい} (narrow defeat)

RELATED:
- {大勝|たいしょう} (big victory - antonym)
- {圧勝|あっしょう} (overwhelming victory)
